specification.title: Curve To Solid Extrusion
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_scope: Primitives, pipe, extrude, revolve, loft/sweep BRep và curve/surface adapters phục vụ trang sức.
specification.parent_exclusions: Không phát triển feature CAD cơ khí như Boss/Rib/Slab.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Curve To Solid Extrusion” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: geometry fixture checks BRep validity/tolerance/closedness or documented intentional open output.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

technical_decisions: Đặt API tạo TopoDS_Shape trong backend OCCT qua qymcad-kernel Shape/Kernel; không đặt BRep constructor trong adapter menu.
Mỗi thao tác phải trả Result<T,DomainError>, BRepCheck_Analyzer validity và classify solid/shell/wire; empty/degenerate input không tạo phantom node.
Kiểm tra face names và persistent references theo qymcad-core names/ref; rebuild và Undo/Redo không đổi topology ngoài chủ đích.

positive.setup: Create the geometry and select the inputs required by: straight extrusion from closed/open profiles
positive.expected: Build exact valid BRep; compare topology, bounding box and area/volume against independent geometry oracle, then save and reopen.

negative.setup: Use degenerate wire, null shape, zero/negative radius/height or impossible tolerance appropriate to Curve To Solid Extrusion
negative.expected: Explicit domain error; document IDs, BRep cache, selection and undo journal unchanged

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test

golden_test_design.input: closed rectangle 10×20 mm extruded z=30 mm
golden_test_design.positive_assertions: valid closed solid V=6000 mm³; extrusion of open wire must remain a face/shell when allowed
golden_test_design.negative_assertions: self-crossing wire or zero height must return typed domain error without partial body

m03_luna_execution_contract.manual_references_precision: Many references are inherited parent-L2 page ranges, not command-exact citations
invariants: OCCT BRep/Geom is truth for exact geometry; mesh/tessellation only derived
No partial document commit on failure or cancellation
Stable object and subobject identity or explicit broken-reference error
No fabricated test receipts, measured values, or manual review
